AI's global race and US-China competition discussed

Discussions and reports highlight the global race for Artificial Intelligence (AI) supremacy, particularly focusing on the competition between the United States and China. Former US President Donald Trump has reportedly been in touch with CEOs to discuss AI safety concerns. Meanwhile, China's People's Daily has stated that AI is not a 'monopoly of great powers,' ahead of a potential meeting between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The coverage also touches upon the dilemma faced by superpowers in retaining power amidst technological advancements.
